IS 7000 : 2026 General Purpose Maximum and Minimum Thermometers - Specification
ICS 17.200.20
ICS 17.200.20
CHD 10
CHD 10
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes requirements of general purpose maximum and minimum thermometers.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of and necessary adjuncts to this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
